title.narrative: STRENGTHENING COASTAL GOVERNANCE AND ECOSYSTEM RESTORATION FOR A RESILIENT

description.narrative: IUCN will implement the project Strengthening Coastal Governance and Ecosystem Restoration for a Resilient Blue Economy in Inhambane Province for the period from September 2024 to August 2025 in 3 districts of Inhambane Province. This project will provide support the Provincial Directorate of Agriculture and Fisheries to implement activities related to coastal management, restoration of biodiversity and ecosystem protection. The project will strengthen the capacity of the DPAP technical teams to better plan coastal management, adaptation to climate change and to respond to coastal communities, particularly women in Morrumbene, Jangamo and Inhambane Districts of Inhambane. Main activities among others are: 1) Conduct a baseline assessment of governance, ecosystems and blue business in Inhambane Seascape 2) Develop a technical assistance and capacity building strategy focusing on activities planning, budgeting, monitoring, sustainable resource management, and gender mainstreaming in policies; 3) Implement long-term technical assistance and capacity building strategy focusing on sustainable resource management. Include modules on gender-sensitive approaches to ecosystem management; 4) Support operationalisation of a Multistakeholder dialogue platform; 5) Nature-based-Solutions and ecosystem restoration; 6) Identify the locations to restore the mangrove ecosystem, coconuts tree and develop the restauration plans using CBNRM approach; 7) Implement pilot restoration plan using CBRNM; and 8) Blue carbon and blue economy feasibility assessment in Inhambane province. The project expects to produce the following outcomes: 1) Status analysis of coastal and marine sector in Inhambane (governance, ecosystems services, market opportunities for blue carbon / blue economy); 2)Technical assistance and capacity building to the Government; 3) Nature-based-Solutions and ecosystem restoration: nurseries for coconut and mangrove trees established, and mangrove ecosystem restored using gender sensitive community-based natural resources management approach (CBNRM) and 4) Market analysis (Blue carbon and regenerative blue economy): feasibility assessments for blue carbon projects and blue economy projects.
